description: On the quays of Île Saint-Louis, between Notre-Dame and the Marais, this magnificent 130 m² first-floor duplex, air-conditioned and luxuriously furnished, combines the charm of the old (high ceilings, parquet floors, mouldings, fireplaces) with modern amenities (sound system, large TVs, heated ceiling, fitted kitchen). The view of the Seine is one of the best in Paris.With 2 double bedrooms + a bathroom and 2 bunk beds, it can accommodate up to 6 guests.The spaceThe duplex apartment is located on the main floor of a listed building, built in 1639. Recently renovated by an architect, it consists of - a very modern and well-equipped entrance/kitchen (Magimix food processor, oven, plate warmer, silverware, etc.) ideal for a dinner for 6;- a large and very elegant living room overlooking the Seine, with a large TV and a functional fireplace - two double bedrooms =air-conditioned= (one on each floor), each with its own bathroom (ensuite upstairs) and dressing room; the downstairs bedroom, baroque style with period paneling, has a fireplace and the upstairs bedroom has a large screen TV. - upstairs, a small office containing two bunk beds (ideal for children).It is located in the heart of Île Saint-Louis, a real "village" in the center of Paris, 200 m from Notre-Dame and facing the Marais, close to many restaurants, grocery stores, florists, bakeries... The charm of the place is unique.
